name: zsys_has_cpuid_support
description: zSys::HasCpuidSupport probes whether the CPU supports CPUID by toggling the EFLAGS ID bit and returns a normalized support flag.
known_limits: Binary Ninja cannot model pushfd/popfd accurately and renders EFLAGS as decomposed booleans, so the reconstruction marker remains limited; assembly evidence validates the raw EFLAGS ID-bit probe.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /DRECOIL_ENABLE_ZSYS_CPU_RAW_ASM /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?HasCpuidSupport@zSys@@YAGXZ at 0x4b33f0 passed with zero unmasked mismatches; Binary Ninja body is 43 bytes and the VC object symbol is 48 bytes with 5 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b33f0 validates initializing result to 1, saving EFLAGS, toggling bit 21, restoring and rereading EFLAGS, clearing result to 0 if the bit did not change, and returning the low word of result.
Native smoke zsys_cpuid_mmx_smoke verifies HasCpuidSupport returns 1 on the runtime CPU and that dependent MMX/signature helpers return normalized booleans.
